artifact_workaround_analysis.workaround_description: Manual creation of empty nv_probe.json and nv_state_db.json files after SE run completion
artifact_workaround_analysis.root_cause: When all executions are validation rejects (body_score_reject=5, body_score_pass=0), state probe update_state() never called, files never written

forensic_runtime_provenance_verdict.error_in_post_campaign_audit: Audit inspected repo-local leftover files instead of verifying runtime environment variables
forensic_runtime_provenance_verdict.forensic_proof_method: Environment variable inspection and SHA256 verification of externally referenced canonical model files
forensic_runtime_provenance_verdict.final_model_identity_conclusion: All 5 SE runs used correct canonical model artifacts matching frozen threshold artifact

validation_gap_identified.gap: Runtime model identity verification not performed during campaign execution
validation_gap_identified.recommendation: Add runtime SHA256 verification at scorer startup: compute hash of loaded checkpoint/metadata, compare against frozen canonical hashes, write verification to scorer trace, fail-closed on mismatch
validation_gap_identified.future_improvement: Provides runtime provenance instead of requiring post-hoc forensic reconstruction
